# exo_safe_links_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing SafeLinksPolicy object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `admin_display_name` (String) Maps to the -AdminDisplayName parameter.
- `allow_click_through` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowClickThrough parameter.
- `custom_notification_text` (String) Maps to the -CustomNotificationText parameter.
- `custom_url_list` (String) Maps to the -CustomUrlList parameter.
- `deliver_message_after_scan` (Boolean) Maps to the -DeliverMessageAfterScan parameter.
- `disable_url_rewrite` (Boolean) Maps to the -DisableUrlRewrite parameter.
- `do_not_rewrite_urls` (String) Maps to the -DoNotRewriteUrls parameter.
- `enable_for_internal_senders` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableForInternalSenders parameter.
- `enable_organization_branding` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableOrganizationBranding parameter.
- `enable_safe_links_for_email` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableSafeLinksForEmail parameter.
- `enable_safe_links_for_office` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableSafeLinksForOffice parameter.
- `enable_safe_links_for_teams` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableSafeLinksForTeams parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `localized_notification_text_list` (String) Maps to the -LocalizedNotificationTextList parameter.
- `make_built_in_protection` (Boolean) Maps to the -MakeBuiltInProtection parameter.
- `recommended_policy_type` (String) Maps to the -RecommendedPolicyType parameter.
- `scan_urls` (Boolean) Maps to the -ScanUrls parameter.
- `track_clicks` (Boolean) Maps to the -TrackClicks parameter.
- `use_translated_notification_text` (Boolean) Maps to the -UseTranslatedNotificationText parameter.
- `use_translated_url_text` (Boolean) Maps to the -UseTranslatedUrlText parameter.
